name: Component library
purpose: The single source of interactive and presentational primitives listed in spa-REQ-006; application screens compose these, they do not restyle them.
responsibilities: Implement every component named in spa-REQ-006 with the states, semantics, and keyboard contracts specified in assets/component-specs.
Consume the semantic token layer exclusively; no hard-coded colours, spacing, or type sizes.
Expose accessibility semantics per component (roles, names, states) and keep them correct across states.
Render the state quartet primitives (empty, loading, error, skeleton) that routes compose per spa-REQ-010.
Keep every interactive target at or above the 24x24 CSS pixel minimum (spa-REQ-019).
internalStructure: One module per component family (actions, inputs, selection, overlays, data display, feedback), each pairing a spec document in assets/component-specs with an implementation the working agent writes.

dependencies.name: Icon set
dependencies.description: The single icon set selected under ADR-206-spa-iconography.

tradeoffs: A closed library slows the first screen slightly and then accelerates every screen after it; ad-hoc one-off components are the defect nursery this component exists to close.
